title: read
description: Budgeted, enveloped file reading — replaces cat, head, tail and sed -n (SDD 9.3). Returns a unit of meaning with precise line anchors and a content hash (the edit staleness anchor); line numbers are verified fresh against mtime+size before return.

symbol.description: Symbol address, e.g. UserService.authenticate or Rust's Config::load, resolved via the index within `file`. Both separators work, and a bare member name resolves when it is unambiguous. Mutually exclusive with lines; needs the Tier-1 index (INDEX_UNAVAILABLE until warm).

lines.description: Explicit 1-based inclusive line range. Mutually exclusive with symbol. Omit both to read the whole file.

surround.description: none: just the unit. enclosing: expand a symbol read to its enclosing parent symbol. imports: additionally return the file's leading import block.
